necessary_context.content: H^d has curvature -1, d>=2, r>0, zeta_r=r/tanh(r). A deterministic first-order query returns f(x) and a subgradient at x. P2 concerns globally geodesically convex, globally M-Lipschitz functions with a global minimizer in B(x_ref,r).
necessary_context.locator: Section 1.1, PDF pp.3–4; zeta notation p.2
necessary_context.name: Setting and Oracle

necessary_context.content: Definition 22 realizes gspan as H^d intersected with the ambient span of specified points and tangent vectors. Proposition 23 identifies it as the minimal totally geodesic submanifold passing through those points and tangent to those vectors. Lemmas 20–21 and Eq. (5) provide the transport and tangency prerequisites used in A.2.
necessary_context.name: Geodesic span

necessary_context.content: A1 requires x_0=x_ref and every later query to lie in the gspan of past queries and subgradients. A2 requires x_k in the intersection of the previously indexed constructed halfspaces L_ell for k<=d-1 on the specified Oracle trajectory.
